## 2024-07-31 - Fix XSS in Gallery View
**Vulnerability:** XSS via innerHTML injection when displaying history items in `loadHistory`. The URL was inserted without sanitization.
**Learning:** Even URLs generated by the app (like image generation) must be sanitized before insertion into the DOM if they can be manipulated in localStorage.
**Prevention:** Use `document.createElement('img')` and set properties directly instead of building HTML strings with user-controlled data.
